⚡️ BETA Release AfterWar 0.5

⚙️ Artificial Intelligence

Added
AI can manage all aspects of the game.
🕯 New Budget Mechanic

Building factories
Reducing corruption percentage and increasing stability percentage
Funding research
Military budget
🌐 Map

Geographic layer
Enhanced detail and quality
Map cyclicality
💥 War

Added
Battles displayed on the map
Conducted through the region panel
Two types: Land and naval battles
Three types of armies: Land, naval, and air forces
Mobilizing the population using political will

Added
Alliance treasury

Added
Defined by factors such as population, stability, corruption, number of factories, and research
Reduces daily political will growth

Added
Required to perform actions in the game: Diplomacy, mobilization
🥸 Languages

Added 4 languages
🎵 Music

Original main theme
Music by SCXLETTE 🔈 Sound effects

Added
More than 20 commands

3 research topics: Air forces, naval warfare, and oceanic warfare

Ability to toggle visibility of naval or land battles
Population map, research map, alliance map, and diplomatic map
📎 Saves

No limit
Saves in .aw format, stored in Documents/My Games/AfterWar/Saves
📌 And much more...

notes.title: AFTERWAR BETA 0.4 - TOTAL UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44552051/3b964fd4f8c05d6a332e44a35b10130513c877f2.png[/img]
Beta 0.4: Total Update
 
What's new?

🌐 Full world map:
- 170+ countries and non-existent territorial "stands"
- Now region = country, but with updates, for example, the USA will be broken down into regions (states) and the whole world
- Each region has a unique population

💵Economic system:
- Income to the budget depends on 3 factors: Stability, corruption, population
- The budget increases every day
- In the "Funding" panel, it will be necessary to provide financing for the needs of fighting corruption and increasing stability
- Needs and income depend on the population
- Stability increases income
- That is, if the stability is 70%, the income is increased by 70%
- Corruption does not dictate the effect of stability, therefore, if the percentage of corruption exceeds stability, the income in the budget is negative!
- It is possible to improve the value of corruption and stability for a fixed amount twice as large as the population
- If the money in the budget (in the financing panel) is 0, then the game ends, it is important not to allow this to happen
- At the beginning of the game, 10% of the budget is for stability and the fight against corruption
- More detailed information about the calculations will be published later

🔫 Annexation:
- The price of a military resource is equally fixed for each country
- In this way, the complexity of the game for small countries is more realized
- Annexation is carried out at the expense of military resources
- The price of annexation depends on the population of the region

🔗Saving:
- 4 slots
- 1 autosave slot

💬Other changes:
- Changing the Steam page
- Changing the game menu, etc

🇺🇦 AfterWar |  Strategy ([url=https://t.me/afterwargame]https://t.me/afterwargame[/url])
